name: Universe
description: A Geometry Dash utility and practice toolkit with all-mode Noclip and switchable Safe Mode.

click-sound.name: Global click sound
click-sound.description: Play the supplied sound for mouse clicks and Android screen taps throughout Geometry Dash.

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode
safe-mode.description: When enabled with Noclip, marks the active run as Practice Mode so it is not treated as a normal completion. Can be toggled at any time.

noclip.name: Noclip
noclip.description: Bypass object and slope collisions in both Normal and Practice Mode. Use Safe Mode to mark the run as Practice Mode.

speedhack-enabled.name: Speedhack
speedhack-enabled.description: Change local gameplay speed. This modifies the PlayLayer update delta and may affect physics or timing.

speedhack-speed.name: Speedhack multiplier
speedhack-speed.description: Gameplay speed multiplier, adjustable from 0.25x to 3.00x in the Universe panel.

practice-tools.name: Practice tools
practice-tools.description: Enable local practice and testing helpers.
